summary.headline: Nazara Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue INR 429 crore and EBITDA INR 46 crore, with a PAT loss of INR 82 crore; Bluetile/BestPlay acquisition restructured to $303 million all-cash.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue was INR 429 crore and EBITDA INR 46 crore, with a PAT loss of INR 82 crore driven by associate losses (about INR 62 crore share of loss) and impairment, mainly on the Moonshine remnant value. Excluding NODWIN's deconsolidation, comparable revenue grew about 9% YoY. Gaming revenue rose 14% YoY to INR 275 crore at a 19.5% EBITDA margin, with heavier user acquisition spend compressing margins at Bluetile, Kiddopia and Curve. Management restructured the Bluetile and BestPlay deal to a fixed $303 million all-cash price, with $89 million at closing and $214 million by 1 April 2027, and named Bluetile founder Raymond Stauffer as Nazara CEO from 1 September 2026.

financial_highlights.change: Largely share of associate losses and impairment

financial_highlights.value: INR 518 crore revenue, INR 55 crore EBITDA
INR 53 crore, EBITDA INR 14 crore (27% margin)
INR 34 crore, EBITDA INR 11 crore (33% margin)

segments.name: Mobile Gaming (Bluetile and BestPlay)
segments.commentary: Revenue grew 54% YoY but EBITDA was flat as UA spend rose from 78% to 85% of revenue; Bluetile EBITDA margin fell to about 11% from 17.6% a year earlier. Revenue net of UA rose from INR 73 crore to INR 80 crore.

segments.name: Kiddopia / Animal Jam
segments.commentary: Kiddopia revenue grew 19% YoY on higher UA spend with 24-month LTV/CAC trending up; Animal Jam revenue grew 11% YoY.

segments.name: Fusebox Games
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 82 crore, up 12% YoY; Love Island ranked #1 in free apps and #5 in top-grossing apps in the US. Big Brother and The Traitors are the next growth drivers.

segments.name: Curve Games (PC and Console publishing)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 53 crore and EBITDA INR 14 crore (27% margin), down from about 40% last financial year; more than 60% of development spend went to new signings and releases start from Q2 FY27.

segments.name: Offline gaming (SMAAASH, Funky Monkeys)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 34 crore and EBITDA INR 11 crore (33% margin); Funky Monkeys revenue grew 58% YoY. SMAAASH 2.0 first reinvention targeted at Lower Parel, Mumbai, in Q4 FY27.

segments.name: AdTech (Datawrkz, Space & Time)
segments.commentary: Datawrkz revenue INR 126 crore with EBITDA INR 3 crore. Management said 60-80% of AdTech revenue is pass-through, so revenue growth does not translate directly into EBITDA.

segments.name: Absolute Sports (Sportskeeda, Pro Football Network)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 28 crore and EBITDA INR 1 crore; Sportskeeda turned EBITDA positive on lower costs, and Pro Football Network posted a 19% EBITDA margin versus break-even in Q1 FY26.

segments.name: NODWIN Gaming
segments.commentary: Q1 is the seasonally weakest quarter with stable revenue and losses substantially lower YoY; organic growth target 30%+ for FY27, with IPO readiness in progress and Comic Con expanding to 14 Indian events.

guidance_outlook: Bluetile and BestPlay to be consolidated from Q2 FY27 subject to final closing; management expects full economics after closing.
No Nazara-level revenue, EBITDA or margin guidance given at this point.
Curve Games expects new titles to lift margins in later quarters; Sovereign Tower launching this week, Dragon Shelter in September 2026, further unannounced titles before year-end.
NODWIN targeting 30%+ organic growth for FY27.
Offline capital commitment across SMAAASH and Funky Monkeys is about INR 50 crore; no further capital allocation decided until SMAAASH 2.0 product-market fit is seen.
Sportskeeda revenue expected to rise in Q2-Q4 with the US sports season.
capex_capacity: Bluetile and BestPlay: $303 million fixed all-cash; $89 million at closing, $214 million in tranches by 1 April 2027 (about $75 million due in 90 days, about $35 million in December 2026, balance before 1 April 2027).
Bluetile holds roughly $20 million of cash on its balance sheet post-acquisition, available to fund the consideration.
SMAAASH 2.0 Lower Parel implementation to start soon, launch expected January-March 2027.
Offline commitments (SMAAASH and Funky Monkeys including stake increase) about INR 50 crore, funded by internal accruals, debt and Nazara capital infusion.
NODWIN raising $100-200 million, including pre-IPO participation; IPO process ongoing.
demand_pricing: Bluetile increased paid UA spend on new games and features after strong ROI on campaigns; management says growth is UA-driven and margin is deferred, not sacrificed.
Management says no caps on UA spend while LTV/CAC guardrails hold.
Human: Fall Flat transaction sales rose YoY; For The King II showing upside in recent months.
Badlands Crew has sold about 50,000-60,000 copies, in line with expectations. Dragon Shelter has about 130,000 Steam wishlists, exceeding expectations.
Curve's new releases will have no in-app purchases forecast; revenue expected from unit sales only. Management does not expect breakout results comparable to Human: Fall Flat (60 million units).
Sportskeeda faced continued Google traffic challenges; diversifying traffic and distribution, and building the Pro Football Network tools business.

qa_highlights.question: Aditya Jawar (AK Investment) asked Bluetile's founder journey and whether growth was organic or inorganic, and what skin in the game Raymond Stauffer would have under the all-cash deal.
qa_highlights.answer: Raymond was not on the call; Maxime Loppin said Bluetile's growth is not organic in the sense of inorganic M&A but is driven by paid UA, with spend based on campaign ROI on new games and features. On incentives, Nitish Mittersain said a structure to incentivise management including Raymond would be communicated over the next few days, with the fundraise not discussed before Board approval.

qa_highlights.question: Samarth Patel (Equirus) asked about the Curve Games release slate, margin trajectory, and offline capex.
qa_highlights.answer: Susan Planck said releases start with Sovereign Tower (this week), Dragon Shelter (September 2026) and more unannounced titles before year-end; Q1 27% margin is below the ~40% of last year and new signings should lift later quarters. Nitish Mittersain said offline commitment across SMAAASH and Funky Monkeys is about INR 50 crore, with SMAAASH 2.0 Lower Parel launch expected January-March 2027 and no further capital decided until product-market fit.

qa_highlights.question: Samarth Patel asked about NODWIN's IPO progress and whether a NODWIN secondary sale would fund the Bluetile consideration.
qa_highlights.answer: Akshat Rathee said Comic Con expands from 11 shows last year to 14 domestic plus 2-3 international, and pre-IPO interest is strong. Nitish Mittersain said funding options include about $20 million of cash on Bluetile's balance sheet, internal cash flow, debt, equity and stake sales, without confirming a NODWIN secondary.

qa_highlights.question: Kunal Bajaj (Choice) asked whether the EBITDA margin decline would normalise quickly, why Bluetile margin fell, D&A outlook, and the timing of the $214 million tranches.
qa_highlights.answer: Nitish Mittersain said margins are deferred as UA is expensed upfront with no caps while LTV/CAC guardrails hold; Bluetile's Q1 margin is about 11% versus 17.6% a year ago. D&A outside Bluetile is steady; Bluetile's amortisation was not quantified. Anupriya Sinha Das said about $75 million is due in 90 days, about $35 million in December 2026, and the balance before 1 April 2027.

qa_highlights.question: Jinesh Joshi (PL Capital) asked why the payment was front-loaded and funded by debt or dilution, whether tax liability arises from real-money gaming notices, and the reason for the ~INR 62 crore associate loss.
qa_highlights.answer: Nitish Mittersain cited performance-based payouts that could reach 180% of committed amounts, misalignment in CEO metrics, and full cash accrual to Nazara instead of 50% leakage to founders. Tax exposure was said to be limited to the investments, which are fully written off. The associate loss was mainly write-offs of remnant Moonshine value after recent judgments, with about 90% already written down earlier.

qa_highlights.question: Rahul Jain (Dolat) asked about Nitish's changed role, Fusebox growth outlook, Sportskeeda recovery, and AdTech margins.
qa_highlights.answer: Nitish said Raymond will run day-to-day operations while he focuses on strategy, M&A and technology. Nitish expects Fusebox's Big Brother and The Traitors to drive the next step-change, without giving a growth figure. Mayank Kumar said Q1 was in line with internal expectations and revenue should rise in Q2-Q4 with the US sports season. Rohit Sharma said AdTech margins are investment-led and that 60-80% of AdTech revenue is pass-through.

qa_highlights.question: Bhavik Shah (Invexa) asked for Bluetile's sustainable margins, full-year outlook, and Nazara-level guidance.
qa_highlights.answer: Maxime Loppin said Q1 margin was about 11% against 17.6% in Q1 FY26, with flexibility to raise EBITDA later and no firm quarterly revenue pattern. Nitish Mittersain said no Nazara-level revenue, EBITDA or margin guidance at this point.

qa_highlights.question: Manan Poladia (MKP) asked for Badlands Crew and Dragon Shelter sales and how the new titles compare with Human: Fall Flat.
qa_highlights.answer: Susan Planck said Badlands Crew has sold about 50,000-60,000 copies, in line with expectations. Dragon Shelter has about 130,000 Steam wishlists, above expectations. Susan said results would not match Human: Fall Flat (60 million units), and the two upcoming releases have no in-app purchase forecast.

risks_watch: Funding of the $214 million balance by 1 April 2027 (about $75 million due in 90 days, about $35 million in December 2026): the mix of debt, equity, stake sales and the Bluetile cash (~$20 million) remains undisclosed, and the investment committee's financing plan was not shared.
Preferential issue and management incentive structure: the Board meeting was due shortly after the call, and details were not given.
Bluetile margin compression (about 11% vs 17.6%) as UA rises to 85% of revenue; margin recovery is deferred and no timeline has been given.
Curve Games margin (27% in Q1 vs about 40% last year) depends on new title releases (Sovereign Tower, Dragon Shelter, unannounced titles) landing in Q2-Q4 FY27.
Sportskeeda and AdTech profitability depends on Google traffic recovery, the US sports season and client budgets. Management said some large margin clients cut budgets.
NODWIN IPO timing and size ($100-200 million raise, pre-IPO), and its valuation, which were not disclosed.
Consolidation of Bluetile and BestPlay from Q2 FY27 is subject to final closing, and Bluetile amortisation has not yet been quantified.
Leadership transition: Raymond Stauffer becomes CEO on 1 September 2026, subject to regulatory approvals.
key_quotes: Yes. I think I will answer for both the businesses or all the gaming businesses. I think the good news is that this is a good reason for the EBITDA decline, which means that while maintaining the guardrails of the LTV/CAC ratio, the revenue we want to make versus the cost we want to spend on user acquisition, while maintaining strong guardrails on that, we are seeing the ability to scale up through enhanced AI implementations, data analytics, and user acquisition capabilities.
It's just that the margins are deferred because all the user acquisition cost is being absorbed upfront. Eventually, this will, of course, normalize into much higher EBITDA margins being reported.
Not at this point of time.
I think our exposure is limited to the extent of our investments in these companies. From a conservative approach, we have written them off completely.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth and strategy, with a more cautious tone on specifics. Management gave firm figures for Q1 segments and the deal payment schedule, but declined to give Nazara-level guidance, the financing plan, the NODWIN secondary, or the preferential issue terms, citing pending Board approval.

growth.why: No Nazara-level revenue or margin guidance was given; comparable ex-NODWIN revenue grew about 9% YoY and gaming revenue rose 14%, with Bluetile + BestPlay (INR 518 crore revenue) expected to consolidate from Q2 FY27, plus NODWIN targeting 30%+ organic growth for FY27 and an offline commitment of about INR 50 crore, though margins are compressing from heavier UA spend.
